kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحدرت (form VII)
# اِنْحَدَرْتُ (inḥadartu) /in.ħa.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# اِنْحَدَرْتَ (inḥadarta) /in.ħa.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# اِنْحَدَرْتِ (inḥadarti) /in.ħa.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# اِنْحَدَرَتْ (inḥadarat) /in.ħa.da.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
